name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_group: Adult women from eligible poor/household categories as per current PMUY rules
eligibility: Applicant must satisfy the current PMUY household and eligibility conditions.
Connection is issued in the eligible woman's name.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection support and related benefits as prescribed under the current scheme.
application_process: Apply through an LPG distributor or the official PMUY process.
source: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / Government of India
